what: PENDING provenance declarations for the Hang-It photograph copies. Merge into image-provenance-records.json 'records' ONLY when the Services page is restored (services_page on), in the same release that publishes the copies. Not merged now: the copies are not on the public site.
logo_not_declarable: The Hang-It logo copy (hang-it-logo.png) has no fitting class in the provenance register: SUPPLIER_IMAGE labels are Photograph or Visualisation only. It needs a founder-approved extension of the register (for example a 'Logo' supplier_label) before it can be published; it must not be mislabelled as a photograph.
